title: Evaluation
description: 200 response of POST /v1/evaluate. The phone stores it in its Evaluation record (TRD 3.3) and copies verdict.event_type and verdict.description into the Moment.

keep.description: Server decision: verdict.save_decision = save. Always true for purpose = describe. false releases the phone's speculative hold.

latency_ms.description: Server time for the whole request.

verdict.description: Model output (TRD 8.2), with enums coerced and text truncated by the server. The model decides; it gives no scores.

save_decision.description: The model's keep-or-skip decision. When it cannot tell, it skips.

best_frame_index.description: 0-based index into the frames sent; always below the number of frames.

window_hint_s.description: Suggested seconds to keep before and after frame t. The phone may extend its hold toward this, up to its own caps.

description.description: At most 20 words, only what is visible. Becomes plan_request clips[].description.

reason.description: At most 25 words. For logs and tuning.
